m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: The King was taken into his Private Chamber by Yacate Farwalker and the Umbra Legion! We can't reach them until the fire is out!
Turn on the fountains to douse the flames!
Please help us! Free us, before the fire dooms us all!
Well done! Hurry to the Private Chamber and save the King! We'll keep your back, out here!
Magician! The Shadow Queen's hand has been revealed! Smash this traitor and free me!
You fool, Axaya, of course it's clear I serve the Shadow Queen! Your light simply makes the shadows longer!
The Outsider may have saved your life, but no matter. I've got what I came for!
You may all die now, as you choose! Ixtab, take me to the Shadow Queen!
I cannot believe I was betrayed by my own advisor!
Come with me to the Throne Room!
Quickly, fly to the Jura Palace and deal with Yacate Farwalker! Save King Axaya Knifemoon from the Shadow Queen's minion!
Quickly, Magician, fly to the Jura Palace and save King Axaya Knifemoon from Yacate Farwalker!
